blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Maddie Madayag admitted Choco Mucho’s back-to-back losses were “very degrading,” but they must find a way to rediscover their winning touch with two matches remaining in the elimination round of the PVL All-Filipino Conference Siklab Series. Choco Mucho fell short of a comeback after Mars Alba’s game-winning block on Sisi Rondina-Rosales clinched Akari’s 25-19, 22-25, 25-21, 19-25, 16-14 conquest on Saturday night at Philsports Arena. After winning three of their first four games, Choco Mucho is now 3-3 tied with their tormentor outside the top four. “The losses are very degrading, but it’s part of the game and […]...
